Frontend Playwright: (1) Happy path — open dialog, select existing supplier + sender, amount 5.000.000 on 2026-09-08 -> 200 + 'Transfer berhasil dicatat'. (2) Inline sender add flow — pre-filled supplier+amount(3.000.000)+date(2026-09-15), then add-sender inline (name+account), save; form state preserved (amount='3.000.000', date='2026-09-15'), new sender auto-selected in sender-select-dropdown trigger text, submission returns success toast 'Transfer berhasil dicatat'. context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 'Supplier tidak ditemukan' when submitting after inline-sender-add is FIXED. TransactionDialog init effect deps [open, editing, defaultDate] correctly no longer resets when suppliers/senders arrays update. Backend tests: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (13 tests, runs in ~3s with pytest-xdist). Note UI seed drift: after prior test runs the calendar shows extra transactions and daily limit changed; call POST /api/seed?force=true if a clean state is needed.
rca of the issue: Root cause was TransactionDialog's init useEffect depending on suppliers and senders arrays. When onCreateSender resolved and updated the senders list, the effect re-ran and reset supplierId/amount/date/note back to defaults, wiping user input; combined with an out-of-sync suppliers list this could cause supplier_id sent to backend to be stale, triggering 404 'Supplier tidak ditemukan'. Fix: (a) trimmed useEffect deps to [open, editing, defaultDate] so the form no longer resets when the parent refreshes suppliers/senders; (b) App.openNewTransaction/openEditTransaction now refetch suppliers+senders from the server before opening the dialog to guarantee fresh IDs. Verified end-to-end via Playwright and pytest regression.
